external_entities.name: duty engineers
external_entities.description: Engineers who use the dispatch console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Duty engineers sit on the corporate network.
external_entities.notes: The source does not state how engineers authenticate to the dispatch console.

external_entities.name: scheduling partner
external_entities.description: Another company that publishes tomorrow's planned work.
external_entities.source_excerpt: A scheduling partner, which is another company, publishes tomorrow's planned work.
external_entities.notes: The source does not state how the partner identifies our importer.

processes.name: dispatch console
processes.description: A single-page JavaScript application used by duty engineers to access dispatch operations and live job status.
processes.source_excerpt: The console is a single-page JavaScript app
processes.notes: The console and the API are served from different origins. The source does not state how engineers sign in.

processes.name: corporate web host
processes.description: The corporate web host that serves the dispatch console.
processes.source_excerpt: our corporate web host serves it
processes.notes: The source does not state the network zone or internet exposure of the host.

processes.name: dispatch API
processes.description: The API called by the dispatch console and schedule importer for dispatch operations.
processes.source_excerpt: The dispatch API runs in the production control plane.
processes.notes: The API answers the console cross-origin, but the allowed origins and credential behavior are not recorded.

processes.name: schedule importer
processes.description: A process that pulls the scheduling partner's SOAP feed, parses XML, archives downloaded documents, and posts parsed work orders to the dispatch API.
processes.source_excerpt: Our schedule importer runs on the corporate network.
processes.notes: The source does not state how the importer identifies the scheduling partner.

data_stores.name: dispatch database
data_stores.description: Database containing job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and the token or session that created each job order, without information about the person behind that token.
data_stores.source_excerpt: That database holds the job orders, the crew names and the crew mobile numbers.
data_stores.notes: Every job order carries the token or session that created it and nothing about the person behind that token. How the database is protected at rest is not written down anywhere.

data_stores.name: schedule archive
data_stores.description: A folder containing each XML document downloaded by the schedule importer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes each document it downloads into the schedule archive
data_stores.notes: The archive is described as a folder on the corporate file store, but its network or trust-zone placement and protection at rest are not stated.

data_stores.name: corporate file store
data_stores.description: The file store on which the schedule archive folder resides.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a folder on the corporate file store
data_stores.notes: The source does not state the network zone, data classification, or protection at rest of the file store.

data_flows.name: open console
data_flows.description: Duty engineers open the dispatch console in a browser.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They open the dispatch console in their browser.

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.description: The dispatch console calls the dispatch API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The console calls the dispatch API.
data_flows.notes: The API is served cross-origin to the console. The configured allowed origins and credential behavior are not recorded.

data_flows.name: live job status
data_flows.description: The dispatch console opens and holds a WebSocket to the dispatch API for live job status.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The console also opens a WebSocket to the dispatch API and holds it open for live job status.
data_flows.notes: The source does not state whether the socket runs over TLS, whether its handshake is authenticated, or whether it rechecks the engineer's session after opening.

data_flows.name: read and write dispatch database
data_flows.description: The dispatch API reads from and writes to the dispatch database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The dispatch API reads and writes the dispatch database.
data_flows.data_description: job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and creating tokens or sessions

data_flows.name: pull SOAP feed
data_flows.description: The schedule importer pulls the scheduling partner's SOAP feed over HTTPS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every hour it pulls the partner's SOAP feed over HTTPS
data_flows.notes: Nothing was written down about how the partner identifies our importer or how our importer identifies the partner.
data_flows.data_description: tomorrow's planned work in an XML document

data_flows.name: write schedule archive
data_flows.description: The schedule importer writes each downloaded XML document into the schedule archive.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes each document it downloads into the schedule archive
data_flows.data_description: downloaded XML documents containing planned work

data_flows.name: post work orders
data_flows.description: The schedule importer posts parsed work orders to the dispatch API using an API token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The importer then posts the parsed work orders to the same dispatch API the console calls.
data_flows.notes: The API token was issued when the importer was built and has not been rotated since.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where duty engineers sit and the schedule importer runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Duty engineers sit on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: production control plane
trust_boundaries.description: A same-company, same-staff zone holding the live estate, with authority to move a crew and change the work a depot does that day.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The dispatch API runs in the production control plane.
trust_boundaries.notes: A corporate laptop holds none of the control-plane rights, and the control plane is not reachable from the internet.

trust_boundaries.name: scheduling partner
trust_boundaries.description: The zone controlled by the scheduling partner, which is another company.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: A scheduling partner, which is another company

assumptions.assumption: The dispatch database's classification is confidential because it holds crew mobile numbers and tokens or sessions associated with job orders.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database holds crew mobile numbers and that every job order carries the token or session that created it.
